points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers read correctly, with digits and symbols in the right order?
Are the four orders visibly separated from each other?
Does the order number #A-10293 keep its hash and order intact?
Does each order show both a Gregorian and a Hijri date?
Does each order show its total in SAR with the digits in order?
Is each status shown as a word, not only a colour?
Do the status labels sit in the same place on every order?
